name: LightNode VPS
line: Provision a virtual server with configurable CPU, memory, and traffic.

free.text: New users may receive up to $15 credit; eligibility and expiry unknown

cells.regions: 41 active nodes/8 regions; other pages say 44 (unclear)

work.math: 100 GB fits the 1 TB plan. 20 builds of 5 minutes each run on the VPS. $0.012 an hour for 672 hours gives $8.064, but the monthly price is capped at $7.71. Domain and tax are not included.

1 vCPU and 2 GB meets the minimum of 1 vCPU and 1 GiB. 100 GB fits within 1 TB. $0.012 an hour for 672 hours conflicts with the $7.71 monthly cap. Performance is untested. Domain and tax are not included.
$7.71 a month server base. 10 GB of same-zone private traffic is free, but the disk price, database fit and daily 7-day backup cost are unknown.
